# MOHI Technical Training Institute

> Smart Student Management & Analytics Platform for MOHI TTI — enrolment, examinations, industrial attachment, job placement, and discipleship in one enterprise dashboard.

## Pages
- [Dashboard](/dashboard): Institutional performance overview with KPIs and charts
- [Students](/students): Student registry with filters
- [Departments](/departments): 8 departments and courses
- [Examinations](/exams): Internal, NITA and KNEC results
- [Attachment](/attachment): Industrial attachment tracking
- [Job Placement](/placement): Graduate employment outcomes
- [Discipleship](/discipleship): Spiritual growth journey tracking
- [AI Insights](/insights): Automated recommendations
- [Reports](/reports): Downloadable filtered reports
